## Mandatory Infin8 ecosystem operations contract

Before cross-repository inspection, changes, builds, packaging, releases, website work, or business operations, read `docs/INFIN8-ECOSYSTEM-OPERATIONS.md` and this repository's `AGENTS.md` in full. Use the versioned `applications.json` command vectors and the Infin8 - Assistant operations runner for coordinated work. Preserve dirty user work and repository-specific authority.
